info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Iodide Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of iodide syrup product details within the catalog. It allows users to create and update essential information about iodide syrup offerings, ensuring that the product data remains accurate and up-to-date. This functionality is crucial for inventory management systems, enabling pharmacies and healthcare providers to maintain detailed records of available syrup products. Typical consumers include pharmacy management software and healthcare applications that require seamless integration to enhance product catalog visibility.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information about iodide syrup, including its composition, usage, and dosage recommendations. Providing accurate and comprehensive details ensures better understanding and application of the product.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows the client to submit details regarding iodide syrup. The request body must contain the required fields to process the information accurately.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details of the iodide syrup.
